birth.date_confidence: Birth date 9 June 1856 attested by Wikidata Q399986, English Wikipedia and Hebrew Wikipedia. A Yiddish biographical lexicon gives 10 June and a contemporary Hebrew account says Shavuot 5616; neither variant was checked against a primary text. Birthplace contested and left unresolved. Pinned here at Troianiv, Zhytomyr Raion, former Volhynian Governorate, because those are the sourced coordinates (Wikidata P19 = Q4464054, en.wiki). Hebrew Wikipedia instead identifies Troyanka, Holovanivsk Raion, southern Podolia, 48.4058N 30.6464E, which coheres far better with the Podolian geography of the rest of the life. Coherence is not evidence; both readings stand.

stops.stop: Degania, the twenty-fourth of Shevat
